messages:
🎉 Barcelona · Sun 15 Nov
No LaLiga this weekend (international break). Jack & Jack play Razzmatazz Mon around 20:30 - listings disagree on room 2 or 3.

TODAY · Sun 15 Nov

1. Churros con Chocolate - 15th anniversary party
🕘 Today from 16:00 (till late) · 📍 Sala Apolo
📊 announced in @sala apolo's story; 15th-anniversary special across Apolo's rooms
💶 From €19.51 on DICE
💬 Barcelona's big Sunday pop party takes over Apolo for its birthday, with Rebolledo in the second room from the evening on.
https://ra.co/events/2581926

2. LasAlturas Market (BCN en las Alturas)
🕘 Today until 21:00 · 📍 Torre Bellesguard (Gaudí), Sarrià
📊 1,347 likes on @planesenbarcelona's weekend round-up; also in their story
💶 €6 (€9 with a drink)
💬 Last day of the fashion, food and live-music market in the gardens of a Gaudí house; an easy late-afternoon plan before going out.
https://www.instagram.com/p/Dfpf9i8Dbxl/

3. SUNDAY VIBES & HAPPY HOUR + STAND UP COMMEDY & LIVE MUSIC
🕘 Tonight 19:00 → 00:00 · 📍 OGHAM
📊 62 going on Meetup (limit 250) · group has 49,884 members
💶 Free to RSVP
💬 The big international Sunday social: happy hour, stand-up and live music in one bar, easy to turn up with friends or alone.
https://www.meetup.com/language-exchange-barcelona-meetup/events/316811209/

4. Placeo pres. Alice Youngling - Afternoon Showcase - Bridge48 with Vibes Live
🕘 Tonight 18:00 → 22:30 · 📍 Bridge 48
📊 92 interested on RA
💬 The closest thing to a tardeo today: an early house and tech-house session that ends before midnight.
https://ra.co/events/2565902

5. Electrostad: FREE PARTY with INOFF, Victor Hugo & friends
🕘 Tonight 23:59 → 05:00 · 📍 Sidecar
📊 253 interested on RA · also on Eventbrite
💶 Free
💬 Free late club night run by local DJs in the Gothic quarter, the busiest proper club listing tonight.
https://ra.co/events/2549258

TOMORROW · Mon 16 Nov

1. Language Exchange & Board Games + Pool & Darts & JAMBOREE DISCO (FREE)
🕘 Mon 19:00 → 06:00 · 📍 La Pecera del Pool
📊 40 going on Meetup (limit 150) · group has 49,884 members · also on Eventbrite
💶 Free
💬 Monday's largest social: language exchange, pool and darts, then free entry to Jamboree for anyone who wants to carry on.
https://www.meetup.com/language-exchange-barcelona-meetup/events/316811212/

2. Tapantoni - Sant Antoni tapas route
🕘 Mon (hours not stated; runs 13-29 Nov) · 📍 Bars across Sant Antoni
📊 1,347 likes on @planesenbarcelona's weekend round-up
💶 Tapa + drink €3.80
💬 Bar-hop the neighbourhood with a set-price tapa and drink at each stop; a good group plan for a quiet Monday.
https://www.instagram.com/p/Dfpf9i8Dbxl/

3. NOMAD RUN ★ 6KM with Entrepreneurs & Digital Nomads feat. La Fabrica &Co ROOFTOP
🕘 Mon 19:00 → 21:00 · 📍 La Fabrica & Co
📊 19 going on Meetup · group has 15,668 members · also on Eventbrite
💶 Free
💬 A 6 km run with founders and digital nomads that ends on a rooftop, so it doubles as tech networking.
https://www.meetup.com/barcelona-digital-nomads-community/events/316897801/

4. Doun Doun Mondays feat. Marga Mbande
🕘 Mon 21:00 → 01:00 · 📍 Sidecar
📊 no public headcount (DICE doesn't publish one)
💶 €12
💬 Seven-piece live afrobeat band with a guest singer and a DJ either side; the liveliest Monday night option.
https://dice.fm/event/yoqdxp-doun-doun-mondays-feat-marga-mbande-16th-nov-sidecar-barcelona-tickets

5. Sondre Lerche
🕘 Mon 20:00 → 23:00 · 📍 Sala Upload
📊 no public headcount (DICE doesn't publish one)
💶 €19.84
💬 Norwegian indie-pop songwriter in a small room, for a proper gig rather than a social.
https://dice.fm/event/wwm2kn-sondre-lerche-16th-nov-sala-upload-barcelona-tickets

Scanned: Meetup 197 · RA 21 · DICE 7 · Xceed 7 · Eventbrite 111 · Luma 4 · Instagram 23 posts + 11 stories.
